events.verdict: Bane (ORL) and Middleton (DAL) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
Carter Jr. (ORL) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he moves to imminently guard an opponent.
Bane (ORL) directly contests Middleton's (DAL) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Middleton's hand after the release.
Gafford (DAL) establishes himself in Bane's (ORL) path prior to the contact.
da Silva (ORL) makes contact with the ball, and with the part of Gafford's (DAL) hand that is on the ball, as he defends Gafford in the lane.
da Silva (ORL) legally contests Gafford's (DAL) shot attempt.
Washington (DAL) wraps his right arm around da Silva's (ORL) body and restricts his FOM.  This contact occurs prior to the ensuing contact that occurs during the pick.
Thompson (DAL) and Suggs (ORL) briefly engage and disengage during rebounding.
Gafford (DAL) maintains verticality as he defends Carter Jr.'s (ORL) shot attempt.  Additionally, Flagg (DAL) cleanly blocks Carter Jr.'s shot.
Carter Jr. (ORL) jumps A to B into Flagg (DAL) as he defends the shot attempt.
Bane (ORL) and Middleton (DAL) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
Middleton (DAL) establishes himself in Banchero's (ORL) path prior to the contact.
Bane (ORL) legally contests Flagg's (DAL) jump shot attempt.
Flagg (DAL) legally contests Carter Jr.'s (ORL) shot attempt.
